text: After the delete, every part of the stack has its pods ready again (not only the replaced pod)
goal: at most 300 seconds after the delete, for the slowest of the five tiers

text: An event that is sent while a pod is being replaced is not lost: it can be read from the REST API afterwards

text: Deleting a pod deletes no data: every tier still has all the records and messages it had
